steps.declaration: export const { op } = PostgresMigrationOp({ name: "migrate-yodel-18-shop-orders-email", env: "<env>", table: "yodel_18_shop.orders", column: "email" });
steps.detail: yodel_18_shop.orders needs expand and contract, which no in-place statement makes, so nothing was sent for it. SQLPG205 Rename a column (columns.email customer_email -> email): RENAME COLUMN is a catalog change, but every reader still using the old name fails the moment it runs: add the new column, write both, move readers, drop the old. https://www.postgresql.org/docs/18/sql-altertable.html Run it as the expand-and-contract migration Op: PostgresMigrationOp({ table: "yodel_18_shop.orders", column: "email", ... }) from @intentius/chant-lexicon-sql/postgres (add the new column, write both, backfill, switch readers, then drop the old).

objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE yodel_18_shop.orders (
      id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,
      email text NOT NULL, -- previously: customer_email
      status text DEFAULT 'placed'::text NOT NULL,
      amount numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
      placed_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
      coupon text,
      refunded_at timestamp with time zone,
      CONSTRAINT orders_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
      CONSTRAINT orders_amount_positive CHECK (amount > 0)
  )
objects.name: orders

objects.ddl: CREATE INDEX orders_status_idx ON yodel_18_shop.orders USING btree (status)
